propositions: review-bot container lacks configured AWS region (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION both unset), causing boto3.client('bedrock-runtime') to raise NoRegionError at provider construction before any model invocation
build_bedrock_provider passes region=None to BedrockProvider when REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION is unset, triggering boto3 ambient resolution which fails silently with NoRegionError
cutover to bedrock:… model fails hard without fallback because region is not configured and boto3 region discovery does not resolve from IMDS inside the container
boto3 region resolution requires AWS_DEFAULT_REGION (not AWS_REGION alone) and is orthogonal to IMDS reachability
pydantic-ai catches boto3.NoRegionError and re-raises pydantic_ai.exceptions.UserError, which is not caught by rebar's LLMError handlers in the fail-closed path
